nom: Amazon Basics Acne Treatment Face Wash - Daily Control Cleanser

avis.texte: It works, no new acne or breakouts when used regularly. But wow it is very irritating and drying! The reviews are not exaggerating! Be sure to have a moisturizer to put on right after. I find this a bit harsher than the panoxyl 10%, though they are comparing this to a clean and clear wash and I haven’t tried that one yet. Not sure if I’d buy it again, I’d rather just spend the extra few bucks for a gentler formula that does the same job.

If you have ever used the Clean & Clear Acne Control product that used to be sold over counter several years ago (it came in a similar deep purple and white bottle) , you would know that this Amazon Basics version is the EXACT same formulation. I have been using this product for years and it truly is a staple product for keeping mild to moderate acne, acne fare ups and hormonal acne under control. I am a primary care physician and often recommend this to my patients and people with acne-prone skin along with other over-the-counter and prescriptions products for their personalized acne regimen. I haven't found another benzoyl peroxide cleanser that is affordable, accessible and as potent as this product. I do caution people that the benzoyl peroxide is known to bleach colored fabrics, so wash hands thoroughly after applying and be mindful of what the treated skin comes in contact with because it can bleach pillow and bed sheets, towels and clothes if used on the body as well. One thing I am not a fan of is it has a whitish pasty residue that sometimes lingers on the skin especially if the skin is oily at baseline, so be mindful of that. You may need do an extra rinse of the face to reduce the film appearance or applying moisturizer, sunscreen and/or makeup which can help to blend it in. It does have a mild menthol fragrance, so if anyone is sensitive to fragrance then do a skin patch test or purchase a fragrance-free alternative. I highly recommend this product due to how effe

avis.titre: Great product. Works great to control acne
avis.texte: So I was born with really bad skin. As soon as I hit puberty, my skin broke out in acne - BIGLY! So as a teenager I finally got it under control. Then, as I aged, the dermatologists never mentioned that acne really doesn’t totally go away when one hits adulthood and beyond. So I’ve been trying to find a decent face wash for my acne and this product is actually pretty good. It smells great and it’s not all runny. It’s thick enough and doesn’t run off my wash cloth or off my face. And it doesn’t sting my face like many acne face washes do. It doesn’t cause my skin to get red and irritated. It actually feels pretty good and moisturizes my skin. I use it every day every morning. It’s great and it’s a great price compared to fancy name-brand brands. Totally worth it!

Unfortunately, this product started to make my skin burn. I only wash my face at night with this and I use a thick moisturizer like aquaphor. I literally have to use ice cubes to attempt to cool down the burning sensation. It does bleach your towels so be careful. Also, it did lather nice and it felt like it was cleaning my skin, but sadly this doesn’t work for me and my acne.

avis.titre: Amazing! It doesn't dry my skin. My rashes are gone.
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin. I also have very oily skin, especially my T zone. My face has a tendency to get dry though. I have allergies to SLS, perfumes, etc. I also have rosacea. This face wash has been amazing. The very first time I used it my face did tingle a LOT and get all red. It only happened the first time though. I was running in to an issue with battling the oil and tendency to get a build up of dead skin, while trying to avoid my face being dry. I was constantly ending up with my face being uncomfortably dry, but when I would try to moisturize it to combat the dryness, I would break out in a rash and/or acne. This face wash has helped my skin so much. I'm able to wash my face to where It keeps the oil in check and gets rid of the dead skin build up, but my face is not dry. My rashes have cleared up. It is also great that it is not expensive. I have a tight budget. Pro tip, use it on your arm pits to help combat body odor. It helps kill the bacteria.
Okay this stuff has been helping the acne on the back of my thighs SO much I love it! It might be a bit harsh for the face, but I only use it on my thighs so I'm not sure. It lasts a while though!

avis.titre: Repurchased because it works!Repurchased because it works!
avis.texte: My husband has already finished one tube, and that’s why we bought it again. It has made a noticeable difference with his back acne and has also helped keep breakouts under control in general. One thing we really like is that it’s effective without being overly irritating or drying when used as directed. The price is great compared to similar products, and a little goes a long way. If you’re looking for an affordable benzoyl peroxide cleanser, this one is definitely worth trying.

This cream does WONDERS. ITS MAGIC. For cystic acne like I USED TO HAVE (not anymore because of this EXACT CREAM) or gor normal pimples. In just a few months I have CLEAR skin, just a few scars from the acne, not the cream. Its amazing. Definitely buy this. I used it EVERYDAY, TWICE A DAY to see the results I saw. Only have to buy 2 bottles to get my skin clear! Love it!

I was recently diagnosed with rosacea. I struggled with it for quite a few months. I'd have pustules, redness and scaly skin on my face. Something I'm not used to having. It made me very insecure. My dermatologist recommended an acne cleanser with benzoyl peroxide. I came across this product and figured I'd give it a try. I do not regret it! If you go by the directions on the back, you won't have any issue using it. My skin is clear. I will definitely continue buying this product! 2nd picture is after use. 3rd picture is before use.

avis.titre: Good stuff, but give me more
avis.texte: The product works well and has definitely improved my skin, but the thing that irks me is the bottles are only filled halfway (that's a brand new, unused bottle in the photo). Seems like a rip off to give us half a product.

This is the worst skincare product I have ever used. I gave it three separate tries, and every single time my skin started itching badly and my eyes became swollen. The reaction was so severe that I had to see a doctor. My eye was in so much pain it hurt to blink and felt like it was going to burst. I was prescribed antibiotic eye drops to treat the reaction. By the time I was able to figure out what was causing the issue and seek medical help, the return window had already closed, which made the situation even more frustrating. I am not allergic to anything, but there is clearly something in this product that caused my lips, eyes, and face to burn and itch intensely. I would strongly recommend avoiding this product, especially if you have sensitive skin.
So far, after 5 days or so, it's helping a lot-5 Apparently, it has some sort of bleach on it, bc it has bleached out and ruined the color of my favorite towel-0! $50 dollars to replace the ruined
I’ve used this for almost two years and it keeps my acne under control. Works just as well as the name brand, but it will stain colored towels. Great value.

avis.titre: Smells good light weight daily face wash routine
avis.texte: This face wash change my skin it’s was the missing piece to my puzzle 🧩 that I finally found. $5 face wash complete change my skin has it under control actually.

This is my second time buying this amazing product. It really works! It cleans my face thoroughly without drying it out, and it doesn’t irritate my skin. It can stain towels, but this won’t happen if you rinse it thoroughly. Highly recommended!

Mucho peor que PanOxyl, pero funciona. Por su precio y porque PanOxyl no envía a Colombia es una alternativa pero recomiendo más el otro de Amazon al 4%. Lo peor que tiene es que es imposible de enjuagar completamente, no importa cuanta agua uno gaste ni que se limpie con la toalla al secarse, siempre deja un residuo que termina causando mucha irritación y manchando las toallas y ropa que uno usa. Es prácticamente inutilizable pero le doy 3 estrellas porque en teoría funciona y es barato.

El limpiador diario para el control del acné de Amazon Basics es una opción efectiva y accesible para quienes buscan combatir el acné. Con un 10% de peróxido de benzoilo, este producto es bastante potente y ayuda a reducir la aparición de brotes. La fórmula se aplica fácilmente y limpia bien la piel sin causar excesiva sequedad, aunque recomiendo usar un hidratante después para evitar la descamación. El tamaño del paquete, que incluye tres envases de 5 onzas cada uno, ofrece una excelente relación calidad-precio. He notado una mejora en la textura de mi piel y una disminución en la cantidad de brotes tras varias semanas de uso regular. Es importante recordar que, debido a la alta concentración de peróxido de benzoilo, es recomendable hacer una prueba de parche antes de usarlo en toda la cara, especialmente si tienes piel sensible.
Great product! My only complaint would be the menthol in it irritates my skin, although the mint smell is refreshing may not be for you if your skin is sensitive.

Something changed with the formula and caused a huge reaction to my skin and eyes. Swelling, irritation, dryness, skin flaking. I have used this product for years and literally subscribe and save, but whatever happened with this last batch has been horrible, and I will never use it again.

I mean, I’ve bought about three different kind of brands in the past. They all work, I mean, it’s benzoyl peroxide. However, this is a great value for what it is. Just get it, you won’t regret it. Also, just be mindful and do your research since the main ingredient tends to dry out the skin. Oh, and I did not read ingredients before hand and it contains “menthol”, the “refreshing feeling”. I personally don’t love that, but the product definitely works.

I thought this would be a good dupe when they stopped selling my other face wash, and for the most part it has, until this morning when I was washing my face I noticed large gel chunks mixed into the normal white face wash consistency. I don’t know what this is, but they are large enough chunks that they won’t even go down my sink drain as shown in the picture.
This product bleaches towels and the neck of your T-shirts. Beware. Also, un-returnable. Works, but WILL bleach everything. I’m throwing this out.

I have used multiple products over the years, but this is the first time I’ve ever had hives. I have never had “sensitive” skin but this product (and yes I did a small skin test days prior to using) caused massive stinging, burning, itching, and hives. I have enough make-up on to hide the destruction but without the make-up I looked like I was beaten. Horrible product!!!

Right out of the packaging the product seemed stuck. The formulation was broken with large clumps of jelly that amassed out of the solution. Squeezed more out and saw the whole tube was like this. Will be returning.

I have very oily and acne prone skin. This picture is 10 min after my 1st use and it still burns with how bad it immediately dried out my skin! It stung a little during the washing portion but I thought it would just stop once the product was actually off my face. I was wrong. It burns!

Personally I had an allergic reaction to the cream. My face is red and hot and itchy. Would have been nice if there was a warning for sensitive skin. I'm lucky I didn't put it other places I get acne could have been a lot worse. Do not recommend if you have any skin sensitivity.
This product ruined $100 worth of towels. Tested all my products to find the culprit.

Anyways, fast forward to today and I woke up like this! Used it last night in the shower, noticed a slight burning after I got out so I put my moisturizer on to calm it down. The bottle did come damaged but it’s fragrance free and great for oily skin without drying out your skin it doesn’t get sudsy it’s more like a cream cleanser

avis.titre: solid knock-off with strong acne medicine
avis.texte: I've been using this 10% benzoyl peroxide cleanser for years. It's really harsh to get started. I wouldn't recommend every day to get started, but if you consistently use this and work up to every day, your acne will be gone. Of course, you wash with soap and water daily, use this regularly, moisturize, and maybe a toner too. I'm not an expert. I pretend to be one on the internet for reviews.

avis.titre: Horrible- My face is still dirty
avis.texte: This is my towel after “washing” my face with this cleanser. I followed directions; scrub for 30 sec, rinse, then pat dry. My face is still dirty (makeup still stuck on) and my eyes burn. I can’t imagine how this could help with acne if it can’t even properly cleanse my face. Do not recommend. Bad face wash!
Doesn’t foam and stains bleach stain marks on all our towels and a handful of tshirts. Definitely don’t recommend
Works great on my face . Very moisturizing after use and leave skin feeling so soft.

My review and rating is not based on the function as a skin cleanser. My review is based on the cleanser's effect on my towels. I washed my face with the cleanser--and rinsed, and rinsed, and rinsed. (My face still felt slick after rinsing for quite a while.) I dried my face off with my towel. The next day, I noticed my light green towel was no long green in some areas. Some areas had turned a tannish color. (See photo.) I suspected it may be the cleanser. So I tested a small dot on one corner. (See photo.) And indeed, the next day that dot was tannish. So beware! Maybe it was the towel material (100% cotton) or maybe it was the type of dye, nonetheless, do be aware of this potential issue.

I’ve used oxy and clean and clear 10% benzoyl peroxide face wash and this has a much stronger off putting chemical / chlorine like smell if that makes sense. It also has chunks of clear jelly like clumps that come out (glycerin?). I’m sure it’s nothing harmful but it’s still weird to see that in your face wash. It does make my face feel clean and helps keep acne at bay

This product has worked so well for me. Appearance of blackheads/acne on my skin Is very little to none. Works better than the C&C I had used previously used. Lather well. Tingly feeling when applied. My skin appearance is everything

This product might work for others but it did not work on me. I used it before I went to bed and when I woke up my face was puffy, red, and very itchy.
